row.title: Catherine de' Medici, Queen and Regent of France
row.citation_text: British Museum Collections Online, Catherine de' Medici, Queen and Regent of France; biography identifies her as Queen from 1547 and regent 1560-63.

row.title: Harriet Tubman
row.citation_text: U.S. National Park Service, Harriet Tubman Underground Railroad National Historical Park; escape in 1849, Underground Railroad work through 1860, Union wartime service and postwar life.

row.title: Harriet Tubman and the 54th Massachusetts
row.citation_text: U.S. National Park Service; records Tubman's volunteer humanitarian work shortly after the Civil War began and later scouting and military support.

row.title: Confucius
row.citation_text: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy, Confucius; describes Lu officeholding, exile among other states, and the traditional return to Lu in 484 BCE while warning that biographical sources mix history and legend.

row.title: Shiji 47 — Hereditary House of Confucius
row.citation_text: Sima Qian, Shiji 47, digital edition at Chinese Text Project; preserves the received narrative of Confucius leaving Lu, traveling among states, and returning to Lu.

row.title: Sanguozhi — Wu Shu I — Biography of Sun Jian
row.citation_text: Chen Shou, Sanguozhi, Wu Shu I, Biography of Sun Jian, Chinese Text Project digital edition; records Han official and military service, Changsha appointment and the anti-Dong Zhuo coalition period.
